name: SettingsForm
title: Templates/Platform/Settings/SettingsForm
summary: A settings form and its save strategy, one variant per strategy. SaveAll, the default (a form that is one logical unit has one save): account-level settings as `Item` rows saved as one unit, a page body for ConsoleLayout (the layout owns the shell and the main landmark): the form column opening with a small page heading, topic sections each a small heading over a flush `Card` of rows, and one full-bleed sticky footer with Discard and Save; Profile is the example, with General (Full name, Email), Preferences (Timezone, Language) and Notifications (Product updates), and Full name and Email flag only after Save is pressed. SavePerGroup splits the page into topic groups whose `Card` footers each carry a secondary Save for that group only. SavePerCard splits a long configuration page into titled cards, each with an info `Alert`, its stacked fields and its own Save beside an optional docs `Link`. Saving one group or card disables just its own fieldset; the others stay editable. Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, `Card`, `Item`, `Alert`, `Field`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Link`, `HelperText` and `Button`.

variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: While the save is in flight: the whole fieldset is disabled, Discard is disabled and Save shows its loading state.

variants.name: SavePerGroup
variants.summary: A settings page split into topic groups that each save on their own: a page heading, then one section per topic, each a small heading over a flush `Card` of `Item` rows whose footer carries a secondary Save for that group only. Saving one group disables just its own fieldset; the other stays editable. Preferences is the example, with General (Full name, Language) and Notifications (Product updates, Security alerts). Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingRow`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneGroup
variants.summary: General is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its rows are disabled, while Notifications stays editable and can be saved on its own.

variants.name: SavePerCard
variants.summary: A long configuration page split into titled cards that each own their save: a page heading, then one `Card` per topic with an info `Alert`, stacked label-and-control fields inside a fieldset, and a footer whose secondary Save commits that card alone, beside an optional docs `Link`. Project settings is the example, with Preview Toolbar and Deployment Protection. Built from `PageHeader`, `Card`, `Alert`, `Field`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Link` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneCard
variants.summary: Preview Toolbar is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its selects are disabled, while Deployment Protection stays editable.
